job.job_description:
Hi




PFA the JD and if you are interested and looking for change please share your resume at sagarika.d.das@pwc.com.




At PwC, our people in data and analytics focus on leveraging data to drive insights and make informed business decisions. They utilise advanced analytics techniques to help clients optimise their operations and achieve their strategic goals.

In data analysis at PwC, you will focus on utilising advanced analytical techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision-making. You will leverage skills in data manipulation, visualisation, and statistical modelling to support clients in solving complex business problems.

The Opportunity

When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. In our innovative hubs, youll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. You’ll also participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and professional skills.
As part of the Data and Analytics team you will develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms for Generative AI projects. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, mentor others, and maintain standards while collaborating with cross-functional teams to apply innovative AI solutions to enterprise challenges. This role allows you to stay at the forefront of advancements in GenAI technologies and make a significant impact on the future of AI solutions.

Responsibilities

Develop and implement machine learning models for Generative AI
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle enterprise challenges
Analyze complex problems and deliver innovative AI solutions
Mentor team members and promote their professional growth
Stay updated on advancements in GenAI technologies
Maintain rigorous standards of quality and compliance in projects
Build meaningful relationships with clients and stakeholders
Navigate complex scenarios to drive impactful results

What You Must Have

Bachelor's Degree
4 years of experience in relevant technical/technology experience with a focus on GenAI projects
Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

Master's Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics preferred
Relevant certifications in data science or GenAI technologies
Excelling in programming with Python, R, or Scala
Skilled in machine learning libraries like TensorFlow and PyTorch
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms such as AWS or Azure
Understanding data privacy and compliance regulations
Experience with developing machine learning applications in production
Knowledge of data visualization tools and techniques
Experience in chatbot design and development
